meta.name: docker-debugger
meta.description: Debug Docker containers, fix Dockerfile issues, optimize images, and troubleshoot docker-compose. Use when having Docker problems, container issues, or optimizing Docker builds.

copy.tagline: 调试容器问题并优化 Docker 镜像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到 Docker 容器运行异常或构建缓慢的问题
copy.tagline_en: Debug container issues and optimize Docker images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter Docker container failures or slow builds

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能诊断 Docker 容器问题、修复 Dockerfile 错误、优化镜像大小，并排查 docker-compose 配置。
howto.when: 当你遇到 Docker 构建失败、容器启动后立即退出、网络连接异常或镜像体积过大等问题时触发。

say.text: 我的 Docker 容器启动后马上退出了，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会检查退出码和日志，给出修复建议。

say.text: 帮我优化这个 Dockerfile，让它更小更安全。
docker-compose 里两个服务连不上，帮我排查。
say.note: Claude 会检查网络配置和容器 IP。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can diagnose Docker container issues, fix Dockerfile errors, optimize image size, and troubleshoot docker-compose configurations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you encounter Docker build failures, containers exiting immediately, network issues, or oversized images.

say_en.text: My Docker container exits immediately, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will check exit codes and logs, then suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this Dockerfile to be smaller and more secure.
say_en.note: Claude will apply multi-stage builds, non-root user, etc.

say_en.text: Two services in docker-compose can't connect, help me debug.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect network settings and container IPs.
